architect.name: Ar. Deepti Singh
architect.title: Architect & Interior Designer
architect.bio: Ar. Deepti Singh is a distinguished Architect and Interior Designer with over 12 years of dedicated practice across residential, commercial, and institutional domains (active in the profession since 2014). Holding a Bachelor of Architecture (First Class) from C.S.V.T.U. Bhilai and specialized Post Graduation in Rural Development from IGNOU Delhi, she bridges contemporary architectural aesthetics with functional, climate-responsive spatial planning. Her portfolio spans ultra-luxury private residences, educational campuses, high-density residential developments, and bespoke interior environments.

experience_history.description: Leading comprehensive architectural design, 3D visualization, municipal sanction drawings, interior turnkey execution, and on-site construction supervision for high-end residential villas and commercial complexes.
Engaged with renowned engineering & valuation firm established in 1988; executed structural coordination, residential blueprints, and institutional projects.
Hands-on drafting, architectural modeling, site inspection, and client presentation drawings.

architect.philosophy: Every architectural form should arise naturally from its context, light, and function. We favor clean geometry, all-white minimalist palettes accented by natural timber and ledgestone, and seamless transitions between indoor living and landscaped courtyards.

render_to_real.title: Render to Reality: Precision in Execution
render_to_real.subtitle: From photorealistic 3D visualization to physical stone, timber, and glass execution.

projects.title: The Minimalist White Villa & Gardens
projects.tagline: Clean minimal aesthetic with an all-white palette, sunken fire pit, and family gardens
projects.description: Designed with a strict aesthetic of restraint, this luxury multi-level villa avoids visual clutter and excess texture, favoring pure architectural volumes bathed in warm architectural lighting. Features include a dedicated kitchen garden, expansive family backyard, sunken fire pit lounge, and cantilevered terrace pergolas.

details.Key Elements: Sunken Fire Pit, Family Lawn, Kitchen Garden, 3D Cutaway Floor Zoning, All-White Minimalist Stucco

projects.title: Classical Arched Villa — Muskan Agrawal
projects.tagline: G+2 neoclassical manor with stepped crown parapet, arched central loggias, and architectural CAD front elevation
projects.description: A grand multi-tier neoclassical residence in Raipur featuring a stepped pyramid rooftop parapet, semicircular central loggias with arched crowning, textured travertine wall cladding, covered cantilever car portico, and complete architectural CAD elevation engineering.

details.Key Elements: Stepped Crown Parapet, Semicircular Arched Loggias, Ornate Wrought-Iron Railings, Full CAD Front Elevation
details.Sections: Section X-X & Section Y-Y Technical Detailing

projects.title: Curvilinear Villa & Penthouse Pool
projects.tagline: Striking curvilinear timber facade with a private rooftop swimming pool
projects.description: An avant-garde residential statement in Ambikapur featuring an undulating timber louvre facade and sweeping curved glass balconies. The top tier features a private rooftop swimming pool flanked by treated wood decking, cascading water spouts, and a sunset lounge.

details.Key Elements: Rooftop Swimming Pool, Curvilinear Wood Facade, Sunset Deck, Statement Round Bed Master Suite

projects.title: The Cantilevered Modernist Manor
projects.tagline: Sculptural interlocking volumes with grey ledgestone cladding and skylight pergola
projects.description: A prime suburban residence in Bhilai defined by bold horizontal cantilevers, split-level car porch, natural stone cladding, and a rooftop skylight lounge. The perimeter boundary wall integrates warm ambient wash lighting that enhances the curb appeal at night.

details.Key Elements: Double Covered Portico, Ledgestone Accent Walls, Skylight Cutouts, Integrated Landscape

projects.title: Livelihood College Campus
projects.tagline: Grand institutional campus featuring monumental colonnade entry and dynamic wing planning
projects.description: A comprehensive institutional facility designed for vocational education and skill development in Raipur. Features symmetrical architectural wings angled around a central civic plaza, solar shading louvers, high-volume atrium, and full CAD elevation engineering.

details.Key Elements: Symmetrical Splayed Wings, Monumental Canopy, CAD Elevation Drawings, Academic Auditoriums

projects.title: The Neoclassical Estate
projects.tagline: Palatial symmetry, arched carriage portico, and expansive manicured lawn estate

details.Key Elements: Classical Archway Carriage Porch, Balustrade Balconies, Central Axial Symmetry, Estate Driveway

projects.title: Vertical Fin Contemporary Duplex
projects.tagline: Illuminated vertical fin screen with panoramic terrace verandas
projects.description: A corner plot contemporary duplex residence in Bhopal highlighting a dynamic illuminated vertical fin screen wall, expansive glass balustrades, textured slate cladding, and deep shaded balconies.

details.Key Elements: Illuminated Vertical Fin Screen, Corner Orientation, Deep Overhangs, Slate Tile Accents

projects.title: Commercial Plaza & Boutique Hotel

technical_drawings.title: CAD Elevation & Section - Institutional College
technical_drawings.description: Precision architectural CAD front elevation, splayed wing geometry, and plinth to parapet datum levels (+14200 MUMTY LEVEL).

technical_drawings.title: Kitchen CAD Furniture & Electrical Schematics

technical_drawings.title: Ground Floor Comprehensive Interior Layout Plate

technical_drawings.title: First Floor Comprehensive Interior Layout Plate
